evals.prompt: I've got a feature spec for adding task comments (DB + API + UI) and I'm not sure where to start or which of our skills apply.
evals.expected_output: Routing through the skill lifecycle starting with planning-and-task-breakdown, surfaced assumptions, and reference to the appropriate downstream skills (build/verify/review).
expectations: Recommends starting with planning-and-task-breakdown given the task is non-trivial and spans multiple layers
References the broader skill lifecycle sequence (plan -> build -> verify -> review) rather than just one skill
Surfaces assumptions explicitly before proceeding, rather than guessing silently
Does not claim verification was completed without evidence
